title: Studio Bagno Launches The Black Book
bodyHtml:
During the winter months, something has been quietly hibernating at Studio Bagno, waiting to come to full fruition before revealing itself. And the time has finally arrived — The Black Book is our new catalogue that integrates multiple functions, and in doing so, becomes a comprehensive, beautiful and useful tool for architects and designers.

“We used to have a very technical manual, a separate price list and a whole lot of nice images that no-one really saw,” says Managing Director Kieran Melrose. 

Although they all had a function, “They didn’t necessarily tell the full story and were also a bit one-dimensional,” he explains.

In comparison, “The Black Book is an all-in-one tool that provides technical and sales information, along with larger in-situ shots to show the product in context. They are beautifully photographed so specifiers can show the images to their clients, and have indicative prices and a good amount of technical info right there in one book. We just wanted to make their jobs easier,” Kieran says.

The Black Book will supersede previous resources, and will be re-released every six months. And although it won’t include the level of technical detail seen in the previous manual, the team has worked hard to select the most relevant and useful information for the compendium.

The catalogue features concise information (both text and technical drawings) on clean white space, interspersed with emotive full-page process and in-situ images. “We just wanted to produce a catalogue that was about consistency and simplicity,” explains Kieran.

As well as being the most functional catalogue in Studio Bagno’s history, Kieran believes it succinctly represents the brand’s current position and direction.

“I really think this is our best collection yet,” he says. “There’s a good amount of sexy, swanky feature pieces, as well as super simple shapes that just work — with the considered details that make them a bit special as well.”
